name: Bosa (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bosa (a castle on blue beneath red and white) in a white cartouche within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Bosa, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bosa arms — castle on blue beneath red and white, crowned, in a cartouche within branches
